programs.name: Amazon Associates
programs.eligibility: Amazon reviews your application after three qualifying sales within 180 days. Personal purchases do not count.
restrictions: Display Amazon’s required Associate identification and a clear disclosure near qualifying links.
Register the sites you actually use. Use official link tools and check the current policies on offline placements, price displays, and site content.
programs.description: Amazon reviews your application after three qualifying sales within 180 days. Personal purchases do not count.
programs.payout: See the approved account’s payout terms

programs.name: Shopify
programs.eligibility: Shopify lists an active website, an established audience, original content, and experience with commerce as application criteria.
restrictions: Apply for the affiliate program through Impact. Check the agreement for qualifying plans, merchant locations and accepted promotional methods.
programs.description: Shopify lists an active website, an established audience, original content, and experience with commerce as application criteria.
programs.payout: See the approved account’s payout terms

programs.name: eBay Partner Network
programs.eligibility: Apply to EPN and review the Network Agreement linked from its rate card.
restrictions: Check each transaction category for commission caps and market-specific exceptions.
The rate card defines separate attribution rules for Buy It Now, auctions and best offers.
programs.cookie: Buy It Now generally within 24 hours
programs.description: Apply to EPN and review the Network Agreement linked from its rate card.
programs.payout: See the approved account’s payout terms

programs.name: Etsy
programs.eligibility: Etsy reviews channel type, site quality, content and brand alignment. Check the policy for the affiliate and creator application paths.
restrictions: Use approved channels. Etsy restricts trademark bidding, direct paid-search linking, automatic redirects and social ads using affiliate links.
Promote only approved Etsy-issued coupons and display expiration dates.
programs.description: Etsy reviews channel type, site quality, content and brand alignment. Check the policy for the affiliate and creator application paths.
programs.payout: See the approved account’s payout terms

restrictions: Check the current agreement for restricted promotion, cancellation and payout terms before placing links or buying traffic.

programs.name: Kinsta

Email and messaging referrals must follow the permitted relationship or opt-in conditions.

programs.eligibility: Apply for affiliate acceptance and register each domain where you intend to use affiliate links.
restrictions: Prohibits competing brand-keyword advertising, self-referrals, cookie stuffing, masking referrers, fake redirects, and automated or incentivized lead generation.
Disclose participation on sites that use affiliate links.
